message.content:
An editorial illustration features a man in green robes and a white cap on a red tricycle, facing a heavy security blockade. His back is to the viewer, and he holds a tassel while raising his right fist. Before him are two grey vehicles with yellow chevron patterns. Armed figures in black gear and one in a grey uniform point handguns from behind these cars and tall grey shields. In the background, massive grey armored tanks with large barrels and glowing lights loom over the scene. A few small figures are visible atop a distant grey structure.

The text includes "TEMPO" in large red letters at the top. Other legible text includes: "Sengkarut Proyek BTS Daerah Terpencil H.76", "Kisruh Penjabat Kepala Daerah H.26", and a main headline: "GAYA-GAYAAN KHILAFAH". Below this, smaller white text begins with "Polisi meringkus pemimpin Khilafatul Muslimin..." and ends with "H.62". At the bottom, a barcode, a QR code, and publication details like "13-19 JUNI 2022" and "RP 50.000" are visible. The scene uses muted blue and grey tones with warm lighting from the sky.
